title: Where should the two lists split?
hook: Two sorted lists can share a middle without being merged.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Find a partition of two sorted arrays whose left sides contain half the combined items.

misconception: The median requires merging every element.
objective: Find a partition of two sorted arrays whose left sides contain half the combined items.

claims.text: The two cuts balance the number of values on each side. Checking the crossed boundary pairs establishes that every left value is at most every right value, without merging the arrays.
